rules.description: Direct insults, slurs, or vulgar language aimed at another person. Casual swearing that is not targeted at anyone is NOT a violation.
Repeated targeting, bullying, personal attacks, stalking, or coordinated pile-ons against a specific user. Use recent-message context to detect sustained harassment.
Attacks or dehumanization based on race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, religion, or disability.
Credible threats of real-world violence, harm, or incitement of violence against a person or group. In-game combat talk (e.g. 'I'll kill your character') is NOT a violation.
Explicit sexual content, sexual solicitation, or sharing of NSFW material in a general chat channel.
Flooding the channel with repeated messages, unsolicited advertising, scam links, or mass mentions. Use recent-message context to detect repetition.
Sharing another person's private information (real name, address, phone, account details) without consent.
